format: raw little-endian float32, row-major, row 0 = southernmost row (y0)
cell_centre: x = x0 + cell*(i+0.5), y = y0 + cell*(j+0.5)
measured_note: uint8 per cell, 1 where a survey point (spot_levels.csv) lies within 5.0 m of the cell centre. Elsewhere the level is the modeller's mesh, not a measurement.
survey_slope_note: float32 per cell, degrees: slope of the raw survey TIN facet under the cell centre (mangalapuram_terrain_15_sept.obj); NaN outside the survey TIN.
